source_semantics.frame_end: clears frame_advance, sets paused to 1, requests exit, and prevents the next frame/VBlank dispatch until the following ui.advance
source_semantics.gdb_stop: permanent breakpoint callback blocks emulation until c
source_semantics.pause_caption: render_update_display writes '<caption> - PAUSED' only after the internal non-paused to paused edge
source_semantics.queue_bound: frame_advance is a boolean and cannot accumulate frames
source_semantics.ui_advance: sets frame_advance boolean to 1 and paused to 0
source_semantics.vdp_status_defined_lower_10: exactly 0x0208/0x020C/0x0228/0x022C at cadence stops: FIFO empty and VBlank, with only the instantaneous HBlank bit and informational sprite-collision latch allowed to vary
source_semantics.vdp_status_upper_bits: bits 15-10 are 68000 prefetch open bus and are ignored
